I replied to Hollis in our direct message: keep **Tuesday, Nov 10 at 15:30** free for the Brindle call.

- **Where the time came from:** On Oct 14, Hollis told me in this direct message that his standing Brindle rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team had moved to Tuesdays at 15:30. That note is saved in the workspace's knowledge base (gbrain), and I found no later change to it. Because it was his own private message, it was fine to tell him.
- **Calendar:** There's nothing on his calendar for Nov 9–15, so the call isn't blocked there yet. I asked if he wants me to add a hold, but I haven't created anything.
- **Small inconsistency:** Our direct message channel only shows today's message, not the Oct 14 one. The answer rests on the saved note alone.
